mentions.name: Pick Up
mentions.description: A reading companion app for tracking books: users can track what they are reading, keep notes and reflections, view reading stats, and build out a personal bookshelf. The app has over 4,000 monthly active users and is built solo, with features added based on reader requests.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been working on Pick Up, a reading companion I built to make tracking books feel a bit more personal and fun.

You can track what you’re reading, keep notes and reflections, see your reading stats, build out your bookshelf, and a bunch more.
mentions.author: thedetailsguy
